source.title: Fishes of Lake Taal: A Field Identification Guide
source.publisher: Department of Agriculture - National Fisheries Research and Development Institute
source.surveyScope: Actual records from fish landed-catch surveys; nine named Batangas municipalities/cities; species pages specify either municipality-level landing sites or the source label 'Lake wide'.

rightsReview.licenseEvidence: Printed page 2 states the guide is distributed under CC BY-NC 4.0.
limits: Reuse and redistribution must remain noncommercial and retain attribution.
No photographs, layouts, guide prose, or page images are copied into the app evidence.
Public reuse is held until source attribution and noncommercial product scope are recorded.

provenance.extractionMethod: Per-species page text extracted from the ordinary authorized NFRDI repository download using pypdf; all 45 scientific names and landing-site labels were checked on their individual source pages.
provenance.sourceUse: Research ledger only; taxonomy and noncommercial publication checks remain pending.

nonClaims: The 2014-2018 study period does not give an exact catch date for any named species.
A 'Lake wide' landing-site label is preserved verbatim and is not converted to every municipality, a catch point, or a lake boundary.
The source's native/introduced labels, common names, diet and status fields are not adopted by this review.
Historical landed catch does not establish current presence, abundance, catchability, legal rules, safety or permission.

taxonomyCrosscheck.method: Exact source-reported-name join to the frozen Catalogue of Life XR freshwater candidate match proposals. This is a search aid, not a fresh lookup or taxonomic approval.
taxonomyCrosscheck.decision: Do not adopt any proposed usage as accepted taxonomy. Four guide names are absent from this freshwater checklist proposal set; the family-conflict and all exact-match proposals require independent review.
